notes: Each case is one room's name, kind and density (null when none). things is Item::Kit.roll's list in the order it is written: each piece a die of kit_die at or under its share, then what lies on or in each piece that came up, then the small stuff at the density's count, no name twice, cut at visible. within is the index in the same list of the piece a thing lies on or in. use_kind, combustible and readable are the tables' for the name, and description is Item::Kit's line. Every die comes from Roll.generator(story: 0, sequence: Zlib.crc32(WorldSeed.natural_key(name)), kind: KIT).
